services.desc: This Novice Hunt will be run in the same manner as one of the Night Song Paranormal Team's investigations. The hope is that attendees may have a personal paranormal experience like, other Paranormal Teams and Major Paranormal TV shows have also experienced while investigating the Famously Haunted Octagon Hall Museum. Octagon Hall Museum is located in Central Standard Time (CDT). Unless otherwise noted, all operating hours and event times listed are CDT. Last tour will be sold 30 minutes before closing. blurb: The Octagon Hall Foundation is a 501-C Non-Profit. Its mission is the historical preservation of the Octagon Hall Museum, surrounding buildings, and property for the next generations to experience. We are run by a volunteer staff that is fueled by a labor of love.
